# MVP Release 1 Backlog

**Status:** Proposed rolling-wave baseline  
**Product Goal:** PG-001  
**Forecast release gate:** 2026-11-08  
**Schedule type:** aggressive evidence-based forecast, not a promise

## Epic roadmap

| Epic | Outcome | Forecast |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EPIC-001 Foundation Stabilization | one coherent, governed, synchronized execution-ready foundation | WC-0000 |
| EPIC-002 Workspace & Configuration | Monad can identify and resolve repository/workspace state deterministically | WC-0001 |
| EPIC-003 Canonical Knowledge Ingestion | supported canonical artifacts become normalized provenance-rich semantic inputs | WC-0001–0002 |
| EPIC-004 Monad Semantic Graph | stable entities and typed relationships form the core knowledge graph | WC-0003 |
| EPIC-005 KIR & Canonical Interchange | validated semantic state has canonical downstream representation | WC-0004 |
| EPIC-006 Diagnostics & Conformance | invalid/contradictory knowledge produces stable actionable diagnostics | WC-0004 |
| EPIC-007 Query & Explanation | users can traverse and explain governing/dependency/evidence paths | WC-0005 |
| EPIC-008 AI Agent Context & Governance | Work Packets produce deterministic minimal Codex context | WC-0006 |
| EPIC-009 CLI & Developer Experience | MVP capabilities are coherent, scriptable, understandable local commands | WC-0007 |
| EPIC-010 Determinism, Security & Performance | the semantic kernel is trustworthy under repeatability, threat, and scale tests | WC-0008 |
| EPIC-011 Change Intelligence & Native Validation | semantic impact can scope and evidence native validation | WC-0009 |
| EPIC-012 Dogfooding & GitHub Projection | Monad can inspect its own repo and project useful engineering state | WC-0010 |
| EPIC-013 Packaging, Documentation & Provenance | users can install/use a traceable release candidate | WC-0011 |
| EPIC-014 MVP Acceptance & Release | end-to-end acceptance proves PG-001 and produces Release 1 | WC-0012 |

## Feature / Work Packet map

Each row is a Feature-sized engineering outcome and its forecast Work Packet. Story IDs are stable backlog identifiers; detailed task decomposition is mandatory before the packet becomes Ready.

| Feature | Work Packet | Sprint | Stories / Enablers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F-001-01 Reconcile foundation authority | WP-STAB-0001 | WC-0000 | US-001 product thesis coherent; EN-001 ADR root singular; EN-002 machine layer green; EN-003 GitHub operating plan |
| F-002-01 Repository identity/config | WP-MVP-0001 | WC-0001 | US-002 detect root; US-003 resolve config; US-004 explain effective config |
| F-002-02 Workspace discovery | WP-MVP-0002 | WC-0001 | US-005 discover supported workspace; US-006 stable ordering; US-007 unsupported structure diagnostic |
| F-003-01 Stable source/document identity | WP-MVP-0003 | WC-0001 | US-008 stable source IDs; US-009 source hashing/provenance; US-010 identity collision diagnostics |
| F-003-02 Markdown engineering parser | WP-MVP-0004 | WC-0002 | US-011 parse sections/metadata; US-012 identifiers; US-013 links/references; US-014 malformed Markdown handling |
| F-003-03 Structured configuration parser | WP-MVP-0005 | WC-0002 | US-015 parse Monad config; US-016 schema errors; US-017 deterministic normalization |
| F-003-04 Reference resolution | WP-MVP-0006 | WC-0002 | US-018 local artifact resolution; US-019 unresolved refs; US-020 typed relation candidates |
| F-004-01 Graph ontology | WP-MVP-0007 | WC-0003 | US-021 core node types; US-022 core edge types; US-023 graph invariants |
| F-004-02 Semantic graph construction | WP-MVP-0008 | WC-0003 | US-024 build graph; US-025 deterministic ordering; US-026 duplicate/conflict handling |
| F-004-03 Graph provenance/integrity | WP-MVP-0009 | WC-0003 | US-027 source provenance; US-028 edge rule provenance; US-029 integrity validation |
| F-005-01 KIR schema & canonicalization | WP-MVP-0010 | WC-0004 | US-030 KIR schema; US-031 canonical serialization; US-032 version marker; US-033 validation |
| F-006-01 Diagnostic contract | WP-MVP-0011 | WC-0004 | US-034 stable diagnostic IDs; US-035 severity/location/entity; US-036 machine/human form |
| F-006-02 Semantic validation engine | WP-MVP-0012 | WC-0004 | US-037 rule evaluation; US-038 authority/reference checks; US-039 deterministic findings |
| F-007-01 Graph query engine | WP-MVP-0013 | WC-0005 | US-040 references/dependents; US-041 governing artifacts; US-042 traceability gaps |
| F-007-02 Explain paths | WP-MVP-0014 | WC-0005 | US-043 why-exists; US-044 governed-by explanation; US-045 missing-knowledge explanation |
| F-008-01 Work Packet semantic contract | WP-MVP-0015 | WC-0006 | US-046 parse WP; US-047 validate authority/scope; US-048 identify acceptance/commands |
| F-008-02 Minimal context selection | WP-MVP-0016 | WC-0006 | US-049 graph neighborhood selection; US-050 exclusion rules; US-051 selection explanation |
| F-008-03 Agent context package | WP-MVP-0017 | WC-0006 | US-052 deterministic package; US-053 Codex profile; US-054 secret minimization; US-055 provenance |
| F-009-01 MVP CLI command surface | WP-MVP-0018 | WC-0007 | US-056 inspect; US-057 validate; US-058 query/graph; US-059 explain; US-060 context |
| F-009-02 CLI output/error contract | WP-MVP-0019 | WC-0007 | US-061 exit codes; US-062 structured output; US-063 no-color/CI behavior |
| F-009-03 Doctor/completion/onboarding | WP-MVP-0020 | WC-0007 | US-064 doctor; US-065 shell completion; US-066 actionable first-run help |
| F-010-01 Determinism conformance suite | WP-MVP-0021 | WC-0008 | US-067 golden fixtures; US-068 cross-run equivalence; US-069 ordering/property tests |
| F-010-02 Untrusted-repository hardening | WP-MVP-0022 | WC-0008 | US-070 path/symlink safety; US-071 no implicit execution; US-072 secret/context exclusions |
| F-010-03 Performance baseline | WP-MVP-0023 | WC-0008 | US-073 reference repos; US-074 latency/memory measurement; US-075 regression budgets |
| F-011-01 Native validation adapter | WP-MVP-0024 | WC-0009 | US-076 capability contract; US-077 invocation evidence; US-078 preserve native exit/result |
| F-011-02 Semantic diff/impact baseline | WP-MVP-0025 | WC-0009 | US-079 graph diff; US-080 affected entities; US-081 validation-scope recommendation |
| F-012-01 Monad self-inspection | WP-MVP-0026 | WC-0010 | US-082 compile Monad repo; US-083 resolve dogfood diagnostics; US-084 publish fixture/evidence |
| F-012-02 GitHub engineering projection | WP-MVP-0027 | WC-0010 | US-085 issue/WP trace; US-086 PR semantic summary baseline; US-087 status projection rules |
| F-013-01 Installation & packaging | WP-MVP-0028 | WC-0011 | US-088 supported install path; US-089 version command; US-090 checksums/artifacts |
| F-013-02 User/reference documentation | WP-MVP-0029 | WC-0011 | US-091 quickstart; US-092 CLI reference; US-093 concepts/troubleshooting |
| F-013-03 Release provenance | WP-MVP-0030 | WC-0011 | US-094 source/artifact manifest; US-095 SBOM baseline; US-096 reproducible release evidence |
| F-014-01 End-to-end acceptance | WP-MVP-0031 | WC-0012 | US-097 clean clone journey; US-098 agent-context journey; US-099 negative/recovery journey |
| F-014-02 Security/release readiness | WP-MVP-0032 | WC-0012 | US-100 threat/control evidence; US-101 open-risk disposition; US-102 release checklist |
| F-014-03 Release candidate & MVP release | WP-MVP-0033 | WC-0012 | US-103 RC validation; US-104 Product Goal acceptance; US-105 release/tag/notes |

## Backlog ordering

Within a Sprint, order by:

1. release-blocking correctness/security risk;
2. dependency/critical-path enablement;
3. Product Goal value;
4. learning/uncertainty reduction;
5. effort and reversibility.

A later item may move earlier when evidence changes the critical path.

## Story acceptance convention

Every story entering Ready must state observable acceptance, relevant negative/boundary behavior, governing specification/ADR if required, verification method, and Work Packet ownership. Story points may support capacity learning but are never converted mechanically to hours or used as productivity targets.

## Task refinement

Tasks for WC-0000–WC-0002 are maintained in the corresponding Work Packet/Sprint records. WC-0003 onward intentionally remains feature/story-level until preceding semantic contracts are validated; this preserves Agile adaptation while keeping the full MVP architecture scheduled.
